euc-2024.notes: Source 1 crawl also holds the 2025 edition pages (year reused). Sources 2 and 3 have the same page text.

sources.evidence: The seed page is titled ICPC EUC 2024 with the heading The 2024 ICPC Europe Championship, dates 22-24 March 2024 and host Czech Technical University in Prague, and 16 of the pages are under home-2024.
DOMjudge table with 52 team rows and columns for problems A to K with minutes and tries, headed ICPC 2024 European Championship final standings.
Text of the page is identical to source 2: the same 52 rows and A to K cells under the heading ICPC 2024 European Championship final standings.
Table of 52 ranked rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, titled The 2024 ICPC Europe Championship.
The cover reads The 2024 ICPC European Championship Official Problem Set and pages 3 to 30 hold statements for problems A to K.
Codeforces dashboard titled European Championship 2024 - Online Mirror listing problems A Grove to K Make Triangle.

euc-2025.notes: Pack location field names Prague, which is the 2024 host; the 2025 pages say University of Porto.

sources.evidence: The seed and the history pages home-2025 with schedule, teams, rules and submits pages state the 2025 ICPC Europe Championship, Porto, 28 February to 2 March 2025.
DOMjudge page titled Scoreboard euc2025 with 53 ranked teams, columns A to K, minutes and tries per cell.
Same DOMjudge Scoreboard euc2025 page: identical visible text, 53 teams, columns A to K.
Table of 53 rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation and no per-problem cells.
28-page PDF titled The 2025 ICPC Europe Championship Problem Set with eleven statements A to K.
Codeforces dashboard of contest 2068 titled European Championship 2025 - Online Mirror listing problems A to K with the championship's problem names.
23-page PDF titled The 2025 ICPC Europe Championship Solutions with one section per problem A to K.

euc-2026.notes: Pack location field names Prague (2024 host). Problem A is Three Castles in the problem set but Three Circles in the solutions PDF; pack uses Three Castles. Source 2 and 4 have no copy; the site's scoreboard and problems addresses are redirect stubs.

sources.evidence: The home-2026 page and its schedule, teams and rules pages state the 2026 ICPC Europe Championship, Warsaw, 6 to 8 February 2026.
15-page PDF whose pages are headed EUC 2026 8.02.2026 with problems A to K, starting with A - Three Castles.
17-page PDF titled The 2026 ICPC Europe Championship Solutions with sections A to K, each with an author line.
